Root cause evidence (AC1), from Windows job 133527199439 (run 43932173744) and a local run of the 133 tests under `PYTHONWARNDEFAULTENCODING=1 -W always::EncodingWarning`:

1. `hatch_build.py:112` writes the generated `src/rebar/_build_info.py` without `encoding`, so on Windows its docstring em dash is cp1252 byte `0x97`. Every UTF-8 whole-tree scan (`tests/_tree_scan.py:40`, `scripts/gen_env_registry.py:320`, wheel/sdist checks) then fails `UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0x97 in position 45` — the traceback shows `input = b'"""Generated at build time by hatch_build.py \x97 do NOT edit...'`. This one defect accounts for most of the 133.
2. `rebar explain plan` exits 1 with `UnicodeEncodeError: 'charmap' codec can't encode characters` (stdout is cp1252 when piped).
3. `binding_repository.py:76` writes `{\r\n ...` (no `newline`), failing 6 byte-exact tests.
4. Test-side locale-default reads (`'charmap' codec can't decode byte 0x90/0x8f/0x9d`), a text-mode CRLF expected-bytes fixture in `test_complexity_baseline.py:493`, and a pytester child decoded as UTF-8 in `test_caplog_coverage_integrity.py`.

Lint rule decision: PLW1514 is preview-only in ruff 0.16.3, and it does not flag `hatch_build.py:112` (Path receiver not inferred) or `subprocess(..., text=True)`, so it would not have caught root cause 1; not adopted. Plan-review rounds added: the CLI-output consumers (reconfiguring stdout to UTF-8 requires parents to decode UTF-8), `hatch_build.py:45` and `reclaim_dry_run.py:239`.

compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem

Discovered from majestic-depilatory-beetle. The advisory `sweep (windows)` job deselects the 133 tests in `.github/windows-sweep-deselect/text-encoding.args`. On Windows, text I/O without `encoding=` uses cp1252 and text writes turn `\n` into `\r\n`. Root causes (evidence in the first comment): `hatch_build.py:112` writes the generated `src/rebar/_build_info.py` in cp1252 (em dash = `0x97`), breaking every UTF-8 tree scan; the CLI's stdio is cp1252, so `rebar explain plan` raises `UnicodeEncodeError`; `src/rebar/reconciler/binding_repository.py:76` writes CRLF; and tests read/write UTF-8 files with the locale codec.

## Approach

Make UTF-8 explicit at each boundary, producer and consumer. No config key, env var or flag is added.

- `hatch_build.py`: `encoding="utf-8"` on `write_text` (`:112`) and on `_build_commit`'s `subprocess.run(..., text=True)` (`:45`); `_read_existing_commit` (`:65`) treats `UnicodeDecodeError` as "no baked SHA".
- `src/rebar/_cli/__init__.py`: a new `_use_utf8_stdio()` called first in `main` (`:306`), before `_main_dispatch`: for each of `sys.stdin`, `sys.stdout`, `sys.stderr` that is an `io.TextIOWrapper` with a non-UTF-8 encoding, `reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")` (no-op on Linux/macOS and under pytest capture). Reconfiguring stdin too keeps pipes between rebar commands (e.g. into `rebar check --stdin`, `_engine_support/gates.py:253`) consistent.
- Product parents that capture rebar CLI output in text mode decode UTF-8 (`encoding="utf-8"`): `reconciler/pass_support.py:225`, `reconciler/run_differs.py:132`, `reconciler/invariant_sink.py:63`, `reconciler/conflict_bug_filing.py:51`, `_commands/reclaim_dry_run.py:341`, plus `reclaim_dry_run.py:239` (`_bare`), so every text-mode `subprocess.run` in these five modules names its encoding. (`_engine_support/validate.py` and `reconciler/invariants.py` only resolve the CLI path; `invariant_sink.py:210` does not capture output.)
- `binding_repository.py:76`: add `newline="\n"`.
- Every PLW1514 site under `src/rebar` and `scripts` gets `encoding="utf-8"`: `_commands/compact_trigger.py:140`, `_commands/fsck_repair.py:419`, `_engine_support/bridge_fsck_drift.py:21`, `_engine_support/next_batch.py:203`, `_engine_support/reads.py:200,256`, `_snapshot/gc_trigger.py:131`, `llm/evals/engine_comparison.py:65,413`, `llm/evals/eval_solver.py:40,52`, `reconciler/apply_planning.py:143,175,235`, `reconciler/pass_io.py:186`, `reconciler/reconcile_helpers.py:281`, `reconciler/sync_logger.py:32`, `reducer/marker.py:24,53`; `scripts/check_deploy_manifest.py:114,135,247`, `check_verify_gate_parity.py:86`, `measure_baseline_normalization.py:188`, `plan_review_contamination_rate.py:66`, `retarget_jira_project.py:39`, `run_live_matrix.py:72`. This change is stacked on the commits for bugs leafy-gorillian-gnat and arctic-unsecular-esok, which already touch `reads.py` and `check_deploy_manifest.py`; any of these sites already carrying `encoding="utf-8"` on the base is left as is. Done when `ruff check --preview --select PLW1514 src scripts` reports nothing.
- Failing tests get `encoding="utf-8"` (bytes comparison where they compare bytes); the pytester child in `test_caplog_coverage_integrity.py` gets `PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8` via `monkeypatch.setenv`.
- Remove each fixed line from `text-encoding.args`; delete the file and its `@` line in `.github/workflows/test.yml` once empty.

## Scope

- `hatch_build.py`, `src/rebar/_cli/__init__.py`, `src/rebar/reconciler/binding_repository.py`, the five CLI-consumer modules, and the PLW1514 sites above
- The failing test modules in `text-encoding.args` that do locale-default text I/O (e.g. `tests/unit/test_alarm_actions_terraform.py`, `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py`, `tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py`, `tests/unit/test_complexity_baseline.py`, `tests/unit/test_caplog_coverage_integrity.py`, `tests/unit/conftest.py`, `tests/_build_provenance_fixture.py`)
- New `tests/unit/test_windows_text_encoding.py`
- `.github/windows-sweep-deselect/text-encoding.args`, `.github/workflows/test.yml`

## Testing

New `tests/unit/test_windows_text_encoding.py`, each failing before its fix on Linux:
- the hatch hook's `initialize` run in a subprocess under `-X warn_default_encoding -W error::EncodingWarning` writes a UTF-8 file; edge: a cp1252 stale `_build_info.py` yields no baked SHA instead of raising.
- `python -m rebar explain plan` with `PYTHONIOENCODING=cp1252` exits 0 with UTF-8 output.
- `_use_utf8_stdio()` with `sys.stdin/stdout/stderr` monkeypatched to cp1252 `io.TextIOWrapper`s over `BytesIO` leaves all three reporting `utf-8`; edge: a non-`TextIOWrapper` stream (e.g. `io.StringIO`) is left untouched.
- an `ast` scan of the five CLI-consumer modules: every `subprocess.run`/`runner.run` with `text=True` also passes `encoding="utf-8"`.
- a `BindingRepository` save with `os.fdopen` routed through `_pyio.open` and `os.linesep` patched to `"\r\n"` writes no `\r` (confirmed locally that `_pyio` honours the patch).

The 133 tests pass under `make verify`; Windows: `gh workflow run test.yml --ref main` after merge.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The class's root cause is recorded on this ticket with the evidence that confirmed it.
- [ ] Each new regression test fails against the pre-fix code and passes after (outcomes recorded in a comment).
- [ ] `ruff check --preview --select PLW1514 src scripts` reports no findings on the merged tree.
- [ ] Every line removed from `text-encoding.args` names a test that passed in a `sweep (windows)` run on main after the fix (run id recorded in a comment).
- [ ] `sweep (windows)` concludes `success` on that run.
